---
title: "Sir Robin Irvine scholarship backs PhD research"
date: 2021-01-01   # year only: the CV lists the scholarship as 2021–2022
description: "Antarctica New Zealand awarded Rodrigo its Sir Robin Irvine Doctoral Scholarship, supporting his PhD research in 2021–2022."
categories: [award, scholarship]
---

Antarctica New Zealand's Sir Robin Irvine Doctoral Scholarship went to Rodrigo Gomez-Fell.
The award supported his PhD research at the University of Canterbury from 2021 to 2022.
